item.title: Paid parking returns to Myrtle Beach in March
item.description: MYRTLE BEACH, S.C. (WBTW) -- Paid parking at downtown Myrtle Beach meters resumes on Sunday. Councilmembers last year voted to bring free parking into metered spaces from 6th Ave S. to 21st Ave N. including beach access points - from Oct. 1 through the end of February. item.title: Marion County authorities investigating deadly nightclub assault
item.description: MARION COUNTY, S.C. (WBTW) -- The Marion County Sheriff's Office is investigating a deadly nightclub assault that happened Sunday morning. Authorities said details were limited, but it happened at Club H20 on U.S. Highway 76. Anyone with information is asked to call (843) 423-8399.
